info.prompt: Close-up of a rogue's dagger-like dice mid-combo break, the "BREAK IT!" prompt flashing crimson as the reversal window shrinks to a sliver. The dice facets show internal crystalline structures glowing electric blue, reflected in the player's cybernetic eye implant. Behind them, the neural cathedral interface arches with gold filigree that resembles both spinal columns and server racks, terminal text scrolling too fast to read. Synthwave lighting casts long violet shadows across the bio-mechanical textures.
